Having been a massive fan of Roller Coaster Tycoon, I've been looking for a decent Theme Park themed game. With much love for classic games, like Roller Coaster Tycoon 1 and Theme Park World, I've never really found a game that captured both a decent park builder game, while also keeping an element of whimsy. The challenges in Planet Coaster aren't all just "get X amount of guests" and "keep overall happiness above X", but also relates to things like keeping a certain theme to your park (Fantasy, Pirate, Space, etc).

The community is great around this game too, with lots available in the Steam Workshop, and in-game you are able to download other people coasters and parks.

One disappointing factor though is the DLC. There are far too many DLC packs, at such a high price tag, and they don't really offer anything in-game. Sure they add items, but there aren't necessary. They don't add any value to the game besides "Hey look at this cool ride I've spent real world money on!", and then forget about it as you maintain the rest of your park.

BEFORE YOU BUY!

Planet Coaster is just about the only game out there that lets you have complete control over your theme park. As of writing this review, the game has gone on sale for $11. If you've been on the fence about getting this game, this is probably the time to get it.

Pros:
+ A lot of customization options and an active workshop community. Really encourages sandbox type play.
+ Looks great. Very immersive.
+ Build accurate coasters with realistic physics or disney-like themed rides

Cons:
- Big parks will affect the framerate, even on high end pcs. If you want to take a smooth first person ride in your coaster it should probably be in a blank map.
- With the high level of customization comes a steep learning curve - I think Rollercoaster Tycoon is still easier to pick up and play.

If Frontier ever added VR support and DX12 this would be a perfect game that could overtake RCT for me. As-is, it's still great especially in these times where I can't go to a theme park.

I have a lot of hours on this game (and I mean A LOT). While i enjoy the game, like the community, there are also, a lot of things I don't like about this game. also like, the community. Eventually after feeling I mastered the lacking coaster design aspect, I opted for a more hardcore challenge in FVD and NL2. Excited for PCO2 after the egregious wait.

I suppose this review is a little early in game time, but I have spent a lot of time before debating on whether or not to get the game. I was never the largest fan of park tycoons on their own. I never even played the classics, just all the Zoo Tycoon games. There the draw was always the animals for me and I did not really even notice Planet Coaster's existence until I saw news about Planet Zoo. From there, I saw many of the positive comments and the sponsored videos endorsing it. All my favorite content creators were sponsored, but even then I simply was not sure if I would enjoy a Planet Zoo without the animals. So I took a leap of faith, maybe because of Frontier producing a game I love, Jurassic World Evolution, and a game I know I will love, Planet Zoo, and their continued DLC support of all the games, but in the end it does not matter. Planet Coaster was a game that had to be played for me to know if it was worth it, and I think it is for what it is worth. It may not be the top game on my list, but especially if you like DLC and need a creative outlet this is a good game for you. If my experience says anything, you need to give it a try before you know for sure.

I've been playing this game ever since it came out and it amazed me back then and now when I turn it on.
Graphics of the game is beautiful, you can do a lot of themed sceneries for you rides, either the views, or buildings, shops, etc. you can do sci-fi, pirates, christmas, fairies, etc.
I love the creating tool how you can actually build everything from the scratch and even the rides, in some ways I prefer the Planet zoo creating tool, but its still very similar.
I love all of the aspects of the game that you can truly build an amazing park.
A lot of DLCs are also themed and you can us it pretty nicely in your park.
Music (you can also upload your own for your rides), decorations, economy, shops, visitors to rides are just amazing.
So if you can't run the PC2 this is a really good choice as well.

Planet Coaster is not a game. It is a theme park design application.

There is a complete lack of management in this "application" and all the focus has been on the design of a theme park. When it comes to designing a theme park it is by far the best application out there. But it is just not a game.

There is no challenge. "the design park takes over so badly that there is nothing too manage" The management elements are poorly executed. Their continuation on making a bad management game with jurassic world evolution confirms that. That (game) was repititive, short, and again, way too much focus on "design"

So, if you look for a fun management game, look elsewhere, if you like to design theme parks, rollercoasters. then this is the application to have.

I do believe frontier developments tries hard, but unfortunately they currently lack the skills to create an awesome management game.

The best themepark simulation in the world, the game supports very realistic parks, and crazy wacky parks. The management is fun and a the right amount of challenging. The roller coasters are realistically designed and are sastifiying to watch as they zip past your walkway. A very photogenic, fun, realistic, and creative game.

Fun game that could of been better with some much needed updates before going on to make a sequel that shows they didn't learn much. It does have fps drops, eats memory like a hungry hippo, buggy pathways, low iQ park guests (they are dumb), notifications bug out, random symmetry problems with building, structure pieces can suddenly glitch, there's more but I'll cut it here.

Despite all that the ability to create almost anything you want and share it with the community is a worthwhile experience. Best advice is to keep your park's size and detailing reasonable or it will crash and take ages to load. Buy complete edition on sale NOW CAN U DIG IT SUCKAAAA!

Gameplay is great until reaching around 5000 guests. Then the screen refresh rate slows down, in turn slowing down all movement in the game. Awesome rides and guest interaction. I hope Frontier continues to add new rides.

While planet coaster may be a great game for the developers themselves and those who have persevered, it's extremely frustrating for the newcommer.

The game has no tutorial at all. None. Opening a career game dumps you in a small theme park with no idea what you are doing. Even were you patient enough to click every UI element to see what it does - and then spend enough time discovering the game mechanics through trial and error - the scenarios drop you straight in playing, never explain what their objective is.

If there is no specific objective, why have a separate sandbox mode?

If you have the motivation, time and patience to spend hours discovering how the game works, you might then be able to discover where in Planet Coaster any fun lies. For everyone else, look for another game with less arrogant developers.

Can be quite overwhelming if you've only ever played RCT. The two are quite similar, but quite different at the same time. This is a very well thought out, modernized version of what should have been RCT 3. Would recommend!

Planet Coaster is a great game that you can spend hours getting lost in. The pathing tool is very flexible and can attach to your buildings' blueprints so you can perfectly fit it inside queue buildings, even though it can be a little frustrating to make plazas with. Another great feature is the building tools, in which you can make almost anything with the many parts given to you.

The track tools also allow for smooth coasters that can do anything you would like. Also, the stock game comes with many different coaster types, from all types of B&M coasters, to Arrow loopers, to launch coasters, to Intamin giga coasters, to woodies and RMC hybrids and single-rails. Anything you want to build is possible, especially with the help of the thememaker's toolkit, in which you can upload creations from a 3d modeling program, such as blender. To add to all of this, the graphics of Planet Coaster are really nice.

All of the flexibility of Planet Coaster allows for a fun game that you can play for hours and create beautiful parks with.

This is probably one of the most relaxing, charming games I've played in a long time. The soundtrack is greatly overlooked, and I actually ended up putting it on my phone to listen to relax. The management portion of the game is pretty easy to work with once you get the hang of it. I recommend watching the video tutorials to get an idea of what to do, especially if you've never played a roller coaster tycoon game before. The career and challenges are very enjoyable and I'm excited for what dlc they'll eventually come out with.

This is the Roller Coaster Tycoon sequel we deserved.

8.5/10

I was a massive fan of RT3, and I was hyped for this game, I even preordered it, and when I first played it, I enjoyed it, but over time I couldn't help its glaring faults. Its path construction meachanics are a prime example of this: when you are doing it EXACTLY the way it wants you to, it performs fine, but do anything else and it begins to feel like the game is actively fighting you, and that isn't a nice feeling. It hurts to leave a negative review of this game, but I just want to warn people going in that this is a game where you have to play by its rules, and even then you'll be plagued with problem child paths and vendors who constantly quit there job "Just because"

TL;DR
I wanted to enjoy it, and you can have fun with it, but it just spends way too much time fighting the player to be enjoyable FOR ME.
Amazing for creatives and management lovers. You better have a good computer! The tag system is wretched, and letting players "add their own tags" to items isn't a feature, it's a flaw.
it is an awesome game 10/10 definitely would recommend to others, and get it while it is 95% off

I used to play a game on Roblox called Roller Coaster Tycoon 2 when I was young. Then I heard of this game and immediately fell in love. I have spent alot of time in this game and I can say that it is in my top 5 favourite games of all time. The amount of customization, special features, and different modes, makes this game fantastic. I could spend hours talking about this game, but if I had to say my favourite part about this game, is how much freedom you have with anything. Building structures, detailing your park, building rides, adding staff, and doing whatever your imagination can come up with, are all things that are possible in this game. Over all rating: 10/10
I love building and decorating these parks. I wish there were more color options. I hope they make a new game similar to this and planet zoo soon. Good games.
If you are looking for a simulator to dump hours and hours into then this is one of the best ones out there. It's fun, relaxing, and lets you explore your creative side.

I've been an avid fan of the original Rollercoaster Tycoon games, as well as Zoo Tycoon games for as long as they have been around. Recently I even played Rollercoaster Tycoon world, which was so disappointing...Frontier took Planet Coaster to a level we have never seen with Rollercoaster Park Simulation games and made it everything anyone could ever want and more. This game has the biggest potential to grow a real franchise and I hope that even with the base game it will grow, not just in the DLCs...

They are coming out with the Jurassic Park Evolution game as well later this year, backed by Universal, which says alot of the company and its success with Planet Coaster.

I believe that where the game needs some work is understandable from the perspective of some of the reviews I have read, however it can't be denied that if you put the time in to learn the game and its mechanics you can teach yourself without needing to be handheld through it. I not only played the tutorial mode but also watched their twitch stream to see how the frontier devs actually create and build things.

Any fan of the original park simulation games I know would love this game and if you are one of those people I urge you to give this game a shot. I don't think you'll be disappointed if you're an avid fan and have patience to learn their structure.

Planet Coaster is a sophisticated and enjoyable game, you have complete freedom in what you can build and create, creators such as Silvarrette is a very good example of this, and shows how amazing things can be in the game, not just in the coasters but in the theming and the buildings themselves. It is a very good time passer and intricate game, since buying this, I have already passed 100 hours and intend on spending even more time within the game.

This is worthy sucessor to RCT. It has all the things from wild coasters to park managment just like the old RTC but in a new more polished packet. That is amazing unfortunally tough in my eyes this game is shallow on some points after a while. It makes it up with a fck load of DLC´s that has surpased the orginial games cost. Wich make the game look half finished. I do recomend this don´t get me wrong, but pick this up on a sale and get every DLC with it instead of paying 37€ + dlc cause its not worth it paying orginial price for everything.

Always been a huge fan of Rollercoaster games.
Bought this game week ago and i love it! The graphics are amazing!

This game does cost some, but it is worth it. This game has beautiful graphics, and neat blueprints you can use for your park. The music in the backround is soft and soothing, as well as the design of the game. Overall it is a great game. Also quick thing, you can't run this on a potato or toaster, but a lemon or kiwi might work.
RT game made me buy this and it's a great game. The one flaw is dlc is quite important to stop the game getting stale but overall i would rate Planet Coaster a solid 7/10 but only get it on sale.

I've been playing this game non-stop for over two years now. I have always loved RCT and have been playing all the roller coaster tycoon games since the first one came out in 1999. While there are some aspects that can't be replicated from the "classic" games, this is the truest form of a sequel I could have ever imagined or asked for, and I feel so blessed to be apart of watching the game grow as it has. Writing this in 2020, I know most of Frontier's focus is in Planet Zoo right now, but the game has so much room to grow and I am excited for the future of Planet Coaster.

I may not be the best at this game, but one thing I know is how good the game itself is. For me, and all other roller coaster enthusiasts, to be able to build our own theme parks with advanced but easy to learn tools is amazing. I may not have an absurd amount of hours on this game (or even many) but in the time I have played it, I could tell it was well made. From the wacky mascots who have their own brands and buildings, to the sky-high, corkscrew roller coasters this game made possible to build, it is truly a good theme park game. (P.S, it's also out on console now).

I loved this game when I had freshly bought it as I played Roller Coaster Tycoon as a kid, but as I've put more time and effort into parks, I have found a lot of issues within the game.

Challenge mode is incredibly easy, but you'll eventually hit a wall with your park.
Building mode is incredibly hard to understand as a beginner and is overwhelming.
You'll find out after a while every park you've ever made, looks and feels the same.
The DLC's are expensive, and in my opinion don't warrant their price tag.
its really great if you have a good computer, but buy the planet coaster 2 instead

For me a game Ive been waiting for all my life! You can create the most amazing theme parcs in this game! For me the piece by piece building and really let your imagination and creativity do the trick.. is the most amazing thing in this game! And even if you are not creative, you can make the most beautifull parcs by using the workshop! So many awesome pieces, mascottes, shops and rides and ofcourse challanges to discover and dont forget about the most beautifull and amazing music they have put into this game! Absolutly a must buy game for everyone! This game is the best! Love this game!

The game has a bit of a learning curve when it comes to staff, shops and facilities, but after those are figured out the rest is pretty solid and intuitive. Would be nice if there were more default blueprints but I suppose that's what the workshop is for.

Overall it seems quite polished. It runs smoothly, the building tools are decent. Be prepared to build your own coasters, and build big, because the pre-built designs usually won't satisfy the challenge requirements.

Very easy to get addicted to. One of my favorite sandbox games for certain.
The main gripe I have with the game is how the coaster editor feels okay at best but is usually janky. I wish there were more options for realism in that regard.
Nevertheless, still a very fun game to sink many hours into.

Built my dream park, accidentally made a bathroom with paid entry.
Vistors cried... with joy.
10/10, masterpiece!

Incredible theme park simulator that's a more than worthy successor to the RCT games with endless customization and creativity. Still surpassed by NoLimits2 in terms of pure coaster creation but this is the best total park sim out there!

I really want to love this game, as I ADORE other rollercoaster simulator/tycoon games.

But the fact that you have to watch a bunch of YouTube tutorials (it literally links you to YouTube on the main menu) before you can even PLAY the game is a bit nonsense. The first "map" in the career mode, that even says "Welcome to Planet Coaster!" just drops you in with zero context or how to's or tutorials on anything. It's super overwhelming to start.

As an adult with not enough time on my hands, I'm a bit bummed that I have to scour tons of videos to even learn how to play the game properly before I can y'know.. Just enjoy and play the game.

It is so much fun to make a crazy roller coaster with ridiculous stats that no one would ride and it's also fun making a successful park with lots of money and making an amazing coaster with great stats. It's a very fun game and Planet Coaster 2 is coming out soon so if it's past November 6th, 2024 and you're reading this then get PC2 cause it has water slides.

Creativity limited by DLC made worse by custom mods. Most if not all of the beautiful creations featured would not work with game mechanics and physics enabled. Whats the point of creating an imaginary theme park that cannot run in simulation mode? It's just a sandbox creation tool best admired in YouTube.
Really fun until you come across an absolute bitch of a level. Worth getting on a good sale but not at full price

So, this game has a lot of potential. But will get boring quick because it will glitch and people will get trapped very easily no matter how wide the sidewalks are and how little decorations there are in a certain area (16g Macbook 2022 and 2015). It's frustrating to build rides and you end up just using premade rides or rides from the community. The community is the best part as there are some really fun builds. There are also no updates, but the developers will shove poorly made DLCs and subscriptions down your throat. I recommend any other theme park game.

I really wanted to love this game. Tycoon, build games are my kind of game and I thought this one was really going to check all the boxes for me, but it didn't. For me, the building was confusing and hard to figure out, the challenges were nearly impossible without having to look up how to do it somewhere else and the controls just never felt right. It was a struggle for me to play, and therefore, not really enjoyable at all. The graphics are awesome, but I really never got the hang of putting a park together and making things work when it was so confusing to figure out how to build. My two cents - stick to the oldies but goodies. This one is too much work.

tldr.text: Very Positive (91%): players love the graphics and art, and the mods and customization.
The price draws the most complaints, while bugs and crashes come up too.

details.text: New players are only at 48% positive, while players with the most hours sit at 96%.
Recent reviews match the long-run picture, since the last month's score is about the same as the all-time 91%.
